parameters.name: MaxNumberOfClientSubscriptions
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of subscriptions per MQTT client, which can be stored in the {{object|#.Client.{i}.Subscription}} table. A value of 0 means no limit.

parameters.name: MaxNumberOfBrokerBridges
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of bridges, which can be configured in the {{object|#.Broker.{i}.Bridge}} table. A value of 0 means no limit.

parameters.name: MaxNumberOfBrokerBridgeSubscriptions
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of subscriptions, which can be stored per bridge instance in the {{object|#.Broker.{i}.Bridge.{i}.Subscription}} table. A value of 0 means no limit.

object.description: Indicates the MQTT capabilities of the device.
